Hello,

posts.author: oroman1026
posts.content_md:
Hey,

SVA class of 92 here. I pretty much got hooked when I took both Holography class as part of my Science requirement at SVA. I don't know of any "Holography Schools" per se but there are many holography studios that offer workshops. I plan on taking Frank DeFreitas workshop (Allentown, PA) as a refresher some time in the summer.
